plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Social Work (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, Version 2026/04/03. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED: the PDF prints Sophomore Spring TOTAL 15 and grand TOTAL: 120, but the listed courses sum to 16 in Sophomore Spring (3+3+4+3+3), making the actual sequenced sum 121. Recorded at the actual sum 121 with the courses as printed. All other printed semester totals (16/16/16/15/15/15/12) reconcile with their course rows. ACCREDITATION STATEMENT: the program 'has achieved candidacy for accreditation by the Board of Accreditation (BOA) of the Council on Social Work Education' (candidacy, not full accreditation). COREQUISITE: 'SW 4081 Practice Seminar is a corequisite of SW 4052 Practice II and must be taken simultaneously' (plan lists SCWK 43232 Practice II and SCWK 40801 Practice Seminar). 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
